```{r define-parameters-eco-shannon}
# --- DEFINE PARAMETERS --- #

response_variable_selected = "shannon"
```

```{r plot-original-data-one-size-per-plot-ecos-shannon, fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ONE PLOT PER ECOSYSTEM SIZE --- #

plot.ecos.sizes.one.by.one.means(ds_ecosystems,
                                 "heterotrophic",

```

 <br>

```{r prepared-data-for-analysis-ecos-shannon}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point %in% time_points_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(trophic_type = as.factor(trophic_type),
         size = as.factor(ecosystem_size_ml),
         conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")),
         disturbance_percentage = as.factor(disturbance_percentage),
         day = as.double(day),
         ecosystem_ID = as.factor(ecosystem_ID))
```

<br>

```{r create-model-ecos-shannon}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage) %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic")

# Model

model = glmmTMB(shannon ~
                  size * conn * dis_per +
                  (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                  (1 | day) +
                  (1 | baseline),
                data = data_for_analysis,
                family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                ziformula = ~ size * conn * dis_per,
                dispformula = ~ size + conn + dis_per + day,
                control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=nlminb,
                                       optArgs=list(method="BFGS")))
```

<details>
<summary>Model residuals coding</summary>
```{r code-model-contrasts-ecos-shannon}

# --- CODE MODEL CONSTRASTS --- #

# Estimate marginal means (Least-squares means)

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * dis_per * size,  # Calculate emmeans for the interaction of conn, dis_per, and size
                         adjust = "sidak",  # Use Sidak adjustment for multiple comparisons
                         bias.adj = TRUE,  # Apply bias adjustment
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite")  # Use Satterthwaite approximation for degrees of freedom

emmeans_output

# Define contrast vectors for each group

uncon_decr_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,15)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 6.43 ml decrease
con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,14)) # Autotrophic, connected, 6.43 ml decrease
uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,13)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 6.43 ml fixed
con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,12)) # Autotrophic, connected, 6.43 ml fixed
uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,11)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 9.00 ml decrease
con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,10)) # Autotrophic, connected, 9.00 ml decrease
uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,9)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 9.00 ml fixed
con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,8)) # Autotrophic, connected, 9.00 ml fixed
uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,7)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 15.00 ml decrease
con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,6)) # Autotrophic, connected, 15.00 ml decrease
uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,5)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 15.00 ml fixed
con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,4)) # Autotrophic, connected, 15.00 ml fixed
uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,3)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 45.00 ml decrease
con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,2)) # Autotrophic, connected, 45.00 ml decrease
uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,1)) # Autotrophic, unconnected, 45.00 ml fixed
con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1) # Autotrophic, connected, 45.00 ml fixed

n_of_digits = 3 # Set number of digits for rounding

# Calculate contrasts using the defined vectors

contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("6.43 ml no interact" = con_fix_6_43 - uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "6.43 ml with interact" = con_decr_6_43 - uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_9 - uncon_fix_9,
                                   "9.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_9 - uncon_decr_9,
                                   "15.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_15 - uncon_fix_15,
                                   "15.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_15 - uncon_decr_15,
                                   "45.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_45 - uncon_fix_45,
                                   "45.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_45 - uncon_decr_45)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  # Convert the contrast output to a data frame
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),  # Round p-value to specified digits
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),  # Round estimate
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),  # Round standard error
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),  # Round degrees of freedom
         t.ratio = round(z.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),  # Round t-ratio (z.ratio)
         e = "",  # Initialize a column for significance indicators
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",  # No symbol if p-value > 0.1
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",  # Add * if p-value < 0.05
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",  # Add ** if p-value < 0.01
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",  # Add *** if p-value < 0.001
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)  # Rename column to show significance markers
```

```{r how-model-contrasts-ecos-shannon}
contrasts
```

<details open="open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r plot-model-residuals-ecos-shannon, fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

# Simulate residuals from the fitted model

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, 
                                      n = 1000) 

# Test for overdispersion in the model to check if variance exceeds mean

testDispersion(simulationOutput)

# Plot Q-Q and Residuals vs Fitted plots

plot(simulationOutput)

# Plot residuals against specific predictors to check if residuals are 
# independent of these variables

plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$day) 
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$size)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$conn)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$dis_per)

# Test for outliers 

testOutliers(simulationOutput)

# Test for zero inflation not accounted for

testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
</details>
